text.1: A tall tower in the sky.
text.2: A very tall tower floats in the sky. Stairs go up and up.
text.3: A very tall tower floats in the sky. A long stair winds up and up past the clouds, and you start to climb.
text.4: A very tall tower floats among the clouds. A long spiral stair winds up and up toward the top, and you take a deep breath and start to climb.

feedback.3: Up, up, up you go, floating past the clouds!

text.2: You walk on soft clouds. They feel like pillows.
text.3: Part of the stair is covered in clouds. They feel as soft as pillows, and you bounce a little with every step.
text.4: Part of the stair is hidden in soft clouds. They feel as springy as pillows, and you bounce a little with every step you take.

feedback.3: You find a snack tucked in the clouds!

text.2: The balloon lands on a balcony. You are almost there!
text.3: The balloon drifts to a stop on a high balcony. You are almost at the top!
text.4: The balloon drifts gently to a stop on a high balcony. You step off, and you can see that you are almost at the very top of the tower!

text.2: A wizard sits alone. He looks sad. He has no friends.
text.3: At the top sits a wizard in a tall purple hat. He looks very sad. He has been alone in the tower for a long time.
text.4: At the very top sits a wizard in a tall purple hat. People call him the Dark Sorcerer, but he only looks sad and lonely. He has been all alone in his tower for a very long time.

feedback.3: The wizard smiles his first smile in years!
The wizard claps along and laughs.

text.3: How did the wizard feel at the top of the tower?
text.4: How did the wizard feel at the top of the tower?

feedback.3: Not quite. Think about the story.
Not quite. Think about the story.

text.2: Your friend helps you to a soft cloud. You rest and feel better!
text.3: Your travel friend helps you onto a soft, fluffy cloud. You rest for a while, and soon you feel strong again.
text.4: Your travel friend helps you onto a wide, fluffy cloud beside the stairs. You rest, nibble a snack, and watch the sky, and soon you feel strong again.

text.1: You did it! You saved the realms!
text.2: You did it! The wizard is happy. You saved the realms!
text.3: You did it! The wizard is not lonely anymore, and he throws a big party. You saved the realms with kindness!
text.4: You did it! The wizard is not lonely anymore, and he throws a big party at the top of the world with all your new friends. You saved the realms with kindness. The end!
